args.message: The three cities with the highest revenue are Bergen (region 1, 823 orders), Rome (region 2, 752 orders) and Vienna (region 3, 570 orders). Revenue is the sum of all order amounts, with orders of every status included. I treated a city as a city name plus its region, so the two cities called Oslo, in regions 1 and 2, were counted separately; neither made the top three.
